body.message:
Hi! I’d like to move out of the apartment on 24 July. Could you please let me know how much I will need to pay for this month?

Also, I’d like the apartment to be inspected while I’m there. Would it be possible to arrange the inspection either on the evening of 23 July or early in the morning on 24 July? My flight is at 12:00 PM on 24 July, so I need the inspection to be completed before I leave.

Thank you!
